title: Building Menu Vision: Real-Time Dish Recognition
summary: Menus aren’t just lists, they’re a window into a restaurant’s unique offerings, specialties, and personality, shaping where and what we choose to eat. But here’s the challenge: reading “Kung Pao Chicken - Stir-fried chicken with peanuts in spicy sauce” doesn’t tell you what the portions look like, whether other diners loved it, or if it matches your expectations. At Yelp, we knew we had the solution sitting in our user-generated content: hundreds of millions of photos, reviews, and prices for dishes. The problem?
